import Mathlib

private def fastFibZ (n : ℕ) : ZMod (10^9) × ZMod (10^9):=
  if n = 0 then (0, 1)
  else
    let (a, b) := fastFibZ (n / 2)
    let c := a * (2 * b - a)
    let d := a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
    if n % 2 = 0 then (c, d) else (d, c + d)
termination_by n
decreasing_by
  apply Nat.div_lt_self <;> omega

private theorem fastFibZ_unfold (n : ℕ) (h : n ≠ 0) :
    fastFibZ n =
      let (a, b) := fastFibZ (n / 2)
      let c := a * (2 * b - a)
      let d := a ^ 2 + b ^ 2
      if n % 2 = 0 then (c, d) else (d, c + d) := by
  unfold fastFibZ
  simp [if_neg h]

private theorem fastFibZ_correct (n : ℕ) :
    fastFibZ n = ((Nat.fib n : ZMod (10^9)), (Nat.fib (n + 1) : ZMod (10^9))) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_rec_on with
  | _ n ih =>
    by_cases h0 : n = 0
    · subst h0; simp [fastFibZ, Nat.fib]
    · have hpos : 0 < n := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero h0
      have hk : n / 2 < n := Nat.div_lt_self hpos (by norm_num)
      have ihk := ih _ hk
      rw [fastFibZ_unfold n h0, ihk]
      simp only
      have hle : Nat.fib (n / 2) ≤ 2 * Nat.fib (n / 2 + 1) :=
        le_trans Nat.fib_le_fib_succ (by linarith [Nat.fib_pos (n / 2 + 1)])
      by_cases he : n % 2 = 0
      · simp only [he, ↓reduceIte]
        constructor
        · rw [show n = 2 * (n / 2) by omega, Nat.fib_two_mul]
          push_cast [Nat.cast_sub hle]; ring
        · rw [show n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2) + 1 by omega, Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one]
          push_cast; ring
      · simp only [he, ↓reduceIte]
        constructor
        · rw [show n = 2 * (n / 2) + 1 by omega, Nat.fib_two_mul_add_one]
          push_cast; ring
        · rw [show n + 1 = 2 * (n / 2 + 1) by omega, Nat.fib_two_mul_add_two]
          push_cast [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hle]; ring

theorem pisano_period_10pow9 : Nat.fib 1500000000 % 10 ^ 9 = 0 ∧ Nat.fib 1500000001 % 10 ^ 9 = 1 := by
  have hcorr := fastFibZ_correct 1500000000
  have hcomp : fastFibZ 1500000000 = (0, 1) := by native_decide
  rw [hcomp] at hcorr
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Prod.mk.inj hcorr
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have : (Nat.fib 1500000000 : ZMod (10^9)) = 0 := h1.symm
    rw [ZMod.natCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] at this
    omega
  · have : (Nat.fib 1500000001 : ZMod (10^9)) = 1 := h2.symm
    have : (Nat.fib 1500000001 : ZMod (10^9)) = ((1 : ℕ) : ZMod (10^9)) := by exact_mod_cast this
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff] at this
    simp [Nat.ModEq] at this
    omega

      have hmdvd : (n / 2 ^ n.factorization 2) ∣ 2 ^ 100 * 5 ^ 100 := (Nat.ordCompl_dvd n 2).trans hd
      have hm5 : (n / 2 ^ n.factorization 2) ∣ 5 ^ 100 := (hcop.symm.pow_right 100).dvd_of_dvd_mul_left hmdvd
      obtain ⟨k, hk100, hk⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow (by norm_num)).mp hm5
      rw [hk] at key
      have hfact5 : n.factorization 5 = k := by
        rw [← key, Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)),
          Finsupp.add_apply, (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)),
          (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 5) (by norm_num))]
        simp
      rw [hfact5]
      exact key.symm
    have hsq_iff : ∀ i j : ℕ, IsSquare (2^i * 5^j : ℕ) ↔ Even i ∧ Even j := by
      intro i j
      constructor
      · rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
        have hrne : r ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hr
        have h2i : i = 2 * r.factorization 2 := by
          have heq := congrArg Nat.factorization hr
          rw [Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)),
            Nat.factorization_mul hrne hrne] at heq
          have h2 := DFunLike.congr_fun heq 2
          rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply,
            (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)),
            (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 5) (by norm_num))] at h2
          simpa [two_mul] using h2
        have h5j : j = 2 * r.factorization 5 := by
          have heq := congrArg Nat.factorization hr
          rw [Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)),
            Nat.factorization_mul hrne hrne] at heq
          have h5 := DFunLike.congr_fun heq 5
          rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.add_apply,
            (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)),
            (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 5) (by norm_num))] at h5
          simpa [two_mul] using h5
        exact ⟨⟨r.factorization 2, by omega⟩, ⟨r.factorization 5, by omega⟩⟩
      · rintro ⟨⟨i', hi'⟩, ⟨j', hj'⟩⟩
        exact ⟨2^i' * 5^j', by rw [hi', hj']; ring⟩
    have hfact_pow : ∀ e f : ℕ, (2^e * 5^f : ℕ).factorization 2 = e ∧ (2^e * 5^f : ℕ).factorization 5 = f := by
      intro e f
      constructor
      · rw [Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)),
          Finsupp.add_apply, (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)),
          (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 5) (by norm_num))]
        simp
      · rw [Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)) (pow_ne_zero _ (by norm_num)),
          Finsupp.add_apply, (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 2) (by norm_num)),
          (Nat.Prime.factorization_pow (p := 5) (by norm_num))]
        simp
    have hkey1 : ∀ a b : ℕ, 0 < a → 0 < b → Nat.lcm a b = 10^100 → IsSquare (Nat.gcd a b) →
        (max (a.factorization 2) (b.factorization 2) = 100 ∧ Even (min (a.factorization 2) (b.factorization 2))) ∧
        (max (a.factorization 5) (b.factorization 5) = 100 ∧ Even (min (a.factorization 5) (b.factorization 5))) := by
      intro a b ha hb hlcm hsq
      have hadvd : a ∣ 2^100 * 5^100 := by rw [← h10, ← hlcm]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left a b
      have hbdvd : b ∣ 2^100 * 5^100 := by rw [← h10, ← hlcm]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_right a b
      have hmax2 : max (a.factorization 2) (b.factorization 2) = 100 := by
        have hh := congrArg (fun n => n.factorization 2) hlcm
        simp only [Nat.factorization_lcm ha.ne' hb.ne', Finsupp.sup_apply] at hh
        rw [h10, (hfact_pow 100 100).1] at hh
        exact hh
      have hmax5 : max (a.factorization 5) (b.factorization 5) = 100 := by
        have hh := congrArg (fun n => n.factorization 5) hlcm
        simp only [Nat.factorization_lcm ha.ne' hb.ne', Finsupp.sup_apply] at hh
        rw [h10, (hfact_pow 100 100).2] at hh
        exact hh
      have hgcddvd : Nat.gcd a b ∣ 2^100 * 5^100 := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b).trans hadvd
      have hgcdne : Nat.gcd a b ≠ 0 := fun h0 => ha.ne' (Nat.eq_zero_of_gcd_eq_zero_left h0)
      have hgcdeq : Nat.gcd a b = 2 ^ (min (a.factorization 2) (b.factorization 2)) * 5 ^ (min (a.factorization 5) (b.factorization 5)) := by
        have hh := hrecon (Nat.gcd a b) hgcdne hgcddvd
        rw [Nat.factorization_gcd ha.ne' hb.ne'] at hh
        simpa [Finsupp.inf_apply] using hh
      have hsq' : Even (min (a.factorization 2) (b.factorization 2)) ∧ Even (min (a.factorization 5) (b.factorization 5)) := by
        rw [hgcdeq] at hsq
        exact (hsq_iff _ _).mp hsq
      exact ⟨⟨hmax2, hsq'.1⟩, ⟨hmax5, hsq'.2⟩⟩
    have hkey2 : ∀ e1 e2 f1 f2 : ℕ, (max e1 e2 = 100 ∧ Even (min e1 e2)) → (max f1 f2 = 100 ∧ Even (min f1 f2)) →
        0 < (2^e1*5^f1 : ℕ) ∧ 0 < (2^e2*5^f2:ℕ) ∧ Nat.lcm (2^e1*5^f1) (2^e2*5^f2) = 10^100 ∧ IsSquare (Nat.gcd (2^e1*5^f1) (2^e2*5^f2)) := by
      intro e1 e2 f1 f2 hDe hDf
      obtain ⟨hde1, hde2⟩ := hDe
      obtain ⟨hdf1, hdf2⟩ := hDf
      have he1 : e1 ≤ 100 := by omega
      have he2 : e2 ≤ 100 := by omega
      have hf1 : f1 ≤ 100 := by omega
      have hf2 : f2 ≤ 100 := by omega
      set a := (2^e1*5^f1 : ℕ) with ha_def
      set b := (2^e2*5^f2 : ℕ) with hb_def
      have hap : 0 < a := by rw [ha_def]; positivity
      have hbp : 0 < b := by rw [hb_def]; positivity
      have hfa2 : a.factorization 2 = e1 := (hfact_pow e1 f1).1
      have hfa5 : a.factorization 5 = f1 := (hfact_pow e1 f1).2
      have hfb2 : b.factorization 2 = e2 := (hfact_pow e2 f2).1
      have hfb5 : b.factorization 5 = f2 := (hfact_pow e2 f2).2
      have hadvd : a ∣ 2^100*5^100 := by
        rw [ha_def]; exact mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow 2 he1) (pow_dvd_pow 5 hf1)
      have hbdvd : b ∣ 2^100*5^100 := by
        rw [hb_def]; exact mul_dvd_mul (pow_dvd_pow 2 he2) (pow_dvd_pow 5 hf2)
      have hlcmeq : Nat.lcm a b = 10^100 := by
        have hln : Nat.lcm a b ≠ 0 := Nat.lcm_ne_zero hap.ne' hbp.ne'
        have hld : Nat.lcm a b ∣ 2^100*5^100 := Nat.lcm_dvd hadvd hbdvd
        have hh := hrecon (Nat.lcm a b) hln hld
        rw [Nat.factorization_lcm hap.ne' hbp.ne'] at hh
        simp only [Finsupp.sup_apply, hfa2, hfb2, hfa5, hfb5] at hh
        rw [hde1, hdf1] at hh
        rw [hh, h10]
      have hgcdsq : IsSquare (Nat.gcd a b) := by
        have hgn : Nat.gcd a b ≠ 0 := fun h0 => hap.ne' (Nat.eq_zero_of_gcd_eq_zero_left h0)
        have hgd : Nat.gcd a b ∣ 2^100*5^100 := (Nat.gcd_dvd_left a b).trans hadvd
        have hh := hrecon (Nat.gcd a b) hgn hgd
        rw [Nat.factorization_gcd hap.ne' hbp.ne'] at hh
        simp only [Finsupp.inf_apply, hfa2, hfb2, hfa5, hfb5] at hh
        rw [hh]
        exact (hsq_iff _ _).mpr ⟨hde2, hdf2⟩
      exact ⟨hap, hbp, hlcmeq, hgcdsq⟩
    apply Nat.card_congr
    refine ⟨fun x => (⟨(x.1.1.factorization 2, x.1.2.factorization 2), ?_⟩, ⟨(x.1.1.factorization 5, x.1.2.factorization 5), ?_⟩),
            fun y => ⟨(2 ^ y.1.1.1 * 5 ^ y.2.1.1, 2 ^ y.1.1.2 * 5 ^ y.2.1.2), ?_⟩,
            ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact (hkey1 x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2).1
    · exact (hkey1 x.1.1 x.1.2 x.2.1 x.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.1 x.2.2.2.2).2
    · exact hkey2 y.1.1.1 y.1.1.2 y.2.1.1 y.2.1.2 y.1.2 y.2.2
    · rintro ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ha, hb, hlcm, hsq⟩
      have hadvd : a ∣ 2^100*5^100 := by rw [← h10, ← hlcm]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_left a b
      have hbdvd : b ∣ 2^100*5^100 := by rw [← h10, ← hlcm]; exact Nat.dvd_lcm_right a b
      ext
      · exact (hrecon a ha.ne' hadvd).symm
      · exact (hrecon b hb.ne' hbdvd).symm
    · rintro ⟨⟨⟨e1, e2⟩, hDe⟩, ⟨f1, f2⟩, hDf⟩
      ext
      · exact (hfact_pow e1 f1).1
      · exact (hfact_pow e2 f2).1
      · exact (hfact_pow e1 f1).2
      · exact (hfact_pow e2 f2).2
  rw [h2, Nat.card_prod, h1]

import Mathlib

def Nat.factors (n : ℕ) : List ℕ:= n.primeFactorsList

theorem liouville_floor_sum (N : ℕ) : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (-1 : ℤ) ^ n.factors.length * ↑(N / n) = ↑(Nat.sqrt N) := by
  have hsplit : ∀ (m n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℤ), Nat.Coprime m n →
      ∑ d ∈ (m*n).divisors, f d = ∑ p ∈ m.divisors ×ˢ n.divisors, f (p.1 * p.2) := by
    intro m n f hmn
    rw [Finset.sum_product]
    rw [Nat.divisors_mul]
    rw [← Finset.sum_product']
    rw [Finset.mul_def]
    rw [Finset.sum_image]
    rintro ⟨x1, y1⟩ h1 ⟨x2, y2⟩ h2 heq
    simp only [Finset.coe_product, Set.mem_prod, Finset.mem_coe, Nat.mem_divisors] at h1 h2
    simp only at heq
    obtain ⟨⟨hx1m, hm0⟩, hy1n, hn0⟩ := h1
    obtain ⟨⟨hx2m, _⟩, hy2n, _⟩ := h2
    have hcop1 : Nat.Coprime x1 y2 := (hmn.coprime_dvd_left hx1m).coprime_dvd_right hy2n
    have hd1 : x1 ∣ x2 := hcop1.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (heq ▸ Dvd.intro y1 rfl)
    have hcop2 : Nat.Coprime x2 y1 := (hmn.coprime_dvd_left hx2m).coprime_dvd_right hy1n
    have hd2 : x2 ∣ x1 := hcop2.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right (heq.symm ▸ Dvd.intro y2 rfl)
    have hx : x1 = x2 := Nat.dvd_antisymm hd1 hd2
    have hx1ne : x1 ≠ 0 := fun h => hm0 (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (h ▸ hx1m))
    have hy : y1 = y2 := Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hx1ne) (hx ▸ heq)
    exact Prod.ext hx hy
  have hmul : ∀ a b : ℕ, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 →
      (-1:ℤ)^((a*b).factors.length) = (-1:ℤ)^(a.factors.length) * (-1:ℤ)^(b.factors.length) := by
    intro a b ha hb
    have hlen : (a*b).factors.length = a.factors.length + b.factors.length := by
      have hp : List.Perm (a*b).primeFactorsList (a.primeFactorsList ++ b.primeFactorsList) :=
        Nat.perm_primeFactorsList_mul ha hb
      simpa [Nat.factors] using hp.length_eq
    rw [hlen, pow_add]
  have hgmul : ∀ m n : ℕ, Nat.Coprime m n →
      ∑ d ∈ (m*n).divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length
        = (∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length) * (∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length) := by
    intro m n hmn
    rw [hsplit m n (fun d => (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length) hmn]
    rw [Finset.sum_product]
    rw [Finset.sum_mul_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro x hx
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro y hy
    rw [Nat.mem_divisors] at hx hy
    have hxne : x ≠ 0 := fun h => hx.2 (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (h ▸ hx.1))
    have hyne : y ≠ 0 := fun h => hy.2 (Nat.eq_zero_of_zero_dvd (h ▸ hy.1))
    exact hmul x y hxne hyne
  have hgprime : ∀ (p k : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → ∑ d ∈ (p^k).divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length = if Even k then 1 else 0 := by
    intro p k hp
    have hsum_alt : ∀ k : ℕ, ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (k+1), (-1:ℤ)^i = if Even k then 1 else 0 := by
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero => simp
      | succ k ih =>
        rw [Finset.sum_range_succ, ih]
        rcases Nat.even_or_odd k with he | ho
        · rw [if_pos he]
          have hodd : Odd (k+1) := he.add_one
          have hne : ¬ Even (k+1) := by simpa [Nat.even_add_one] using he
          rw [if_neg hne, hodd.neg_one_pow]
          norm_num
        · have heven : Even (k+1) := ho.add_one
          rw [if_neg (by simpa [Nat.even_add_one] using ho)]
          rw [if_pos heven, heven.neg_one_pow]
          norm_num
    rw [Nat.divisors_prime_pow hp k, Finset.sum_map]
    simp only [Function.Embedding.coeFn_mk]
    have hlen : ∀ i : ℕ, (p^i).factors.length = i := fun i => by simp [Nat.factors, hp.primeFactorsList_pow]
    simp_rw [hlen]
    exact hsum_alt k
  have hcopsq : ∀ a b : ℕ, Nat.Coprime a b → (IsSquare (a*b) ↔ IsSquare a ∧ IsSquare b) := by
    intro a b hab
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
      have heq : a * b = c^2 := by rw [hc]; ring
      obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := exists_eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow (a := a) (b := b) (by rw [Nat.isUnit_iff]; exact hab) heq
      obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := exists_eq_pow_of_mul_eq_pow (a := b) (b := a) (by rw [Nat.isUnit_iff]; exact hab.symm) (by rw [mul_comm]; exact heq)
      exact ⟨⟨d, by rw [hd]; ring⟩, ⟨e, by rw [he]; ring⟩⟩
    · rintro ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, ⟨y, hy⟩⟩
      exact ⟨x*y, by rw [hx, hy]; ring⟩
  have hppow_sq : ∀ (p k : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → (IsSquare (p^k) ↔ Even k) := by
    intro p k hp
    constructor
    case mpr => rintro ⟨j, hj⟩; exact ⟨p^j, by rw [hj]; ring⟩
    rintro ⟨r, hr⟩
    have hr2 : p^k = r^2 := by rw [hr]; ring
    have hfeq : (p^k).factorization p = (r^2).factorization p := by rw [hr2]
    simp [Nat.factorization_pow, hp.factorization_self] at hfeq
    exact ⟨r.factorization p, by omega⟩
  have hg : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length = if IsSquare n then (1:ℤ) else 0 := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | _ n ih =>
      intro hn1
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hn1 with h1 | h1
      · simp [← h1, Nat.factors]
      · have hn0 : n ≠ 0 := by omega
        have hne1 : n ≠ 1 := by omega
        set p := n.minFac with hp_def
        have hp : p.Prime := Nat.minFac_prime hne1
        have hpdvd : p ∣ n := Nat.minFac_dvd n
        set k := n.factorization p with hk_def
        have hkpos : 0 < k := hp.factorization_pos_of_dvd hn0 hpdvd
        set m := n / p^k with hm_def
        have hnm : p^k * m = n := Nat.ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self n p
        have hcop : Nat.Coprime p m := Nat.coprime_ordCompl hp hn0
        have hcopk : Nat.Coprime (p^k) m := hcop.pow_left k
        have hp1 : 1 < p := hp.one_lt
        have hpk1 : 1 < p^k := Nat.one_lt_pow (by omega) hp1
        have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := by
          intro h
          rw [h, mul_zero] at hnm
          exact hn0 hnm.symm
        have hmlt : m < n := by
          rw [← hnm]
          calc m = 1 * m := (one_mul m).symm
          _ < p^k * m := by
              apply Nat.mul_lt_mul_right (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm0) |>.mpr
              exact hpk1
        have hm1 : 1 ≤ m := Nat.one_le_iff_ne_zero.mpr hm0
        have ihm := ih m hmlt hm1
        rw [← hnm, hgmul (p^k) m hcopk, hgprime p k hp, ihm]
        by_cases hk : Even k
        · have hsqpk : IsSquare (p^k) := (hppow_sq p k hp).mpr hk
          have heqv : IsSquare (p^k*m) ↔ IsSquare m := by
            rw [hcopsq (p^k) m hcopk]
            simp [hsqpk]
          rw [if_pos hk]
          by_cases hm : IsSquare m
          · rw [if_pos hm, if_pos (heqv.mpr hm)]; norm_num
          · rw [if_neg hm, if_neg (fun h => hm (heqv.mp h))]; norm_num
        · have hnsqpk : ¬ IsSquare (p^k) := fun h => hk ((hppow_sq p k hp).mp h)
          have hnsq : ¬ IsSquare (p^k*m) := by
            rw [hcopsq (p^k) m hcopk]
            simp [hnsqpk]
          rw [if_neg hk, if_neg hnsq]
          ring
  have hswap : ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (-1:ℤ)^n.factors.length * (↑(N/n) : ℤ)
      = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length := by
    have hcard : ∀ n : ℕ, ((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter (fun m => n ∣ m)).card = N / n := by
      intro n
      rw [show Finset.Icc 1 N = Finset.Ioc 0 N from rfl]
      exact Nat.Ioc_filter_dvd_card_eq_div N n
    have hdiv : ∀ n : ℕ, (↑(N/n) : ℤ) = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (if n ∣ m then (1:ℤ) else 0) := by
      intro n
      rw [← hcard n, Finset.card_filter]
      push_cast
      rfl
    calc ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (-1:ℤ)^n.factors.length * (↑(N/n):ℤ)
        = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (-1:ℤ)^n.factors.length * ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (if n ∣ m then (1:ℤ) else 0) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro n hn; rw [hdiv n]
      _ = ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (if n ∣ m then (-1:ℤ)^n.factors.length else 0) := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro n hn
          rw [Finset.mul_sum]
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro m hm
          by_cases h : n ∣ m <;> simp [h]
      _ = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ n ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (if n ∣ m then (-1:ℤ)^n.factors.length else 0) := Finset.sum_comm
      _ = ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ n ∈ m.divisors, (-1:ℤ)^n.factors.length := by
          apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
          intro m hm
          rw [Finset.mem_Icc] at hm
          rw [← Finset.sum_filter]
          congr 1
          ext n
          simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Nat.mem_divisors]
          constructor
          · rintro ⟨⟨hn1, hnN⟩, hdvd⟩
            exact ⟨hdvd, by omega⟩
          · rintro ⟨hdvd, hm0⟩
            refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, hdvd⟩
            · exact Nat.pos_of_dvd_of_pos hdvd (by omega)
            · exact le_trans (Nat.le_of_dvd (by omega) hdvd) hm.2
  have hcount : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, (if IsSquare m then (1:ℤ) else 0) = (Nat.sqrt N : ℤ) := by
    have hcardeq : ((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter IsSquare).card = Nat.sqrt N := by
      have himg : (Finset.Icc 1 N).filter IsSquare = (Finset.Icc 1 (Nat.sqrt N)).image (fun k => k*k) := by
        ext m
        simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_Icc, Finset.mem_image]
        constructor
        · rintro ⟨⟨hm1, hmN⟩, r, hr⟩
          refine ⟨r, ⟨?_, ?_⟩, hr.symm⟩
          · rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos r with h0 | hpos
            · exfalso; rw [h0] at hr; simp at hr; omega
            · exact hpos
          · rw [Nat.le_sqrt, ← hr]; exact hmN
        · rintro ⟨k, ⟨hk1, hkN⟩, hkm⟩
          subst hkm
          refine ⟨⟨?_, ?_⟩, k, rfl⟩
          · nlinarith
          · exact Nat.le_sqrt.mp hkN
      have hinj : Function.Injective (fun k : ℕ => k*k) := by
        intro a b hab
        simp only at hab
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (a - b), sq_nonneg (b - a)]
      rw [himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective _ hinj]
      rw [Nat.card_Icc]
      omega
    rw [← hcardeq, Finset.card_filter]
    push_cast
    rfl
  rw [hswap]
  have heq2 : ∑ m ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ d ∈ m.divisors, (-1:ℤ)^d.factors.length

        norm_cast

        norm_cast

    have hkey : ∀ (m:ℕ) (e : Equiv.Perm (Fin m)) (q : Fin m),

          simp at this
        · rw [Polynomial.isUnit_iff] at hu
          obtain ⟨r, hr, hrc⟩ := hu
          have hdeg : f.natDegree = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C c).natDegree + g.natDegree := by
            rw [hg]; exact Polynomial.natDegree_mul (Polynomial.X_sub_C_ne_zero c) (by rw [← hrc]; exact (Polynomial.C_ne_zero.mpr hr.ne_zero))
          rw [hfdeg, Polynomial.natDegree_X_sub_C, ← hrc, Polynomial.natDegree_C] at hdeg
          omega
      have hnotmem : ∀ c : ZMod p, algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f) c ≠ α := by
        intro c hceq
        apply hnoroot c
        have heq2 : (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)) (c ^ 2 - 3 * c + 1) = 0 := by
          rw [map_add, map_sub, map_pow, map_mul, map_one, hceq]
          exact hα_eq
        have hinj := (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)).injective
        have hc0 : c ^ 2 - 3 * c + 1 = 0 := by
          apply hinj
          rw [heq2, map_zero]
        show f.eval c = 0
        rw [hf_def]
        simp [hc0]
      have hne : α ^ p ≠ α := by
        intro hEq
        set g : Polynomial (AdjoinRoot f) := Polynomial.X ^ p - Polynomial.X with hg_def
        have hp1 : p ≠ 1 := (Fact.out (p := Nat.Prime p)).one_lt.ne'
        have hpge2 : 2 ≤ p := (Fact.out (p := Nat.Prime p)).two_le
        have hgdeg : g.natDegree = p := by
          rw [hg_def]
          compute_degree!
          · rw [if_neg (fun h => hp1 h.symm)]
            simp
          · omega
        have hgne : g ≠ 0 := by
          intro hcontra
          rw [hcontra, Polynomial.natDegree_zero] at hgdeg
          omega
        set S : Finset (AdjoinRoot f) := insert α (Finset.image (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)) Finset.univ) with hS_def
        have hScard : S.card = p + 1 := by
          rw [hS_def, Finset.card_insert_of_notMem]
          · rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)).injective, Finset.card_univ, ZMod.card]
          · simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
            rintro ⟨c, hc⟩
            exact hnotmem c hc
        have hSsub : S ⊆ g.roots.toFinset := by
          rw [hS_def]
          intro x hx
          rw [Multiset.mem_toFinset, Polynomial.mem_roots hgne]
          simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hx
          rcases hx with hx | ⟨c, hxc⟩
          · rw [hx]; show g.IsRoot α; rw [hg_def]; simp [Polynomial.IsRoot, hEq]
          · rw [← hxc]
            show g.IsRoot (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f) c)
            have heq2 : (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f) c) ^ p = algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f) c := by
              rw [← map_pow, ZMod.pow_card]
            rw [hg_def, Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_pow, Polynomial.eval_X, heq2, sub_self]
        have hcard_le : S.card ≤ g.natDegree := by
          calc S.card ≤ g.roots.toFinset.card := Finset.card_le_card hSsub
          _ ≤ g.roots.card := Multiset.toFinset_card_le _
          _ ≤ g.natDegree := Polynomial.card_roots' g
        rw [hScard, hgdeg] at hcard_le
        omega
      exact ⟨hne, hβeq⟩
    obtain ⟨hβne, hβeq⟩ := h3
    have h5 : α + α ^ p = 3 ∧ α * α ^ p = 1 := by
      have hne : α - α ^ p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hβne)
      have key : (α - α ^ p) * (α + α ^ p - 3) = 0 := by linear_combination hα_eq - hβeq
      have hsum' : α + α ^ p - 3 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp key).resolve_left hne
      have hsum : α + α ^ p = 3 := sub_eq_zero.mp hsum'
      have hprod : α * α ^ p = 1 := by linear_combination α * hsum - hα_eq
      exact ⟨hsum, hprod⟩
    obtain ⟨hsum, hprod⟩ := h5
    have h6 : α ^ (p + 1) = 1 := by
      rw [pow_succ, mul_comm, hprod]
    have h7 : ∀ n : ℕ, (a n : AdjoinRoot f) * (α - α ^ p) = α ^ n - (α ^ p) ^ n := by
      have key : ∀ m : ℕ, (a m : AdjoinRoot f) * (α - α ^ p) = α ^ m - (α ^ p) ^ m ∧
          (a (m+1) : AdjoinRoot f) * (α - α ^ p) = α ^ (m+1) - (α ^ p) ^ (m+1) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero => constructor <;> simp [ha0, ha1]
        | succ k ih =>
          obtain ⟨ih0, ih1⟩ := ih
          refine ⟨ih1, ?_⟩
          rw [hrec k]
          push_cast
          linear_combination 3 * ih1 - ih0 - α ^ k * hα_eq + (α ^ p) ^ k * hβeq
      intro n
      exact (key n).1
    have h8 : (a (p - 1) : AdjoinRoot f) = -3 := by
      have hp2' : 2 ≤ p := (Fact.out (p := Nat.Prime p)).two_le
      have e2 : p - 1 + (p + 1) = 2 * p := by omega
      have key1 : α ^ (p - 1) = (α ^ p) ^ 2 := by rw [← pow_mul, mul_comm p 2, ← e2, pow_add, h6, mul_one]
      have hnz : α ^ p ≠ 0 := by rintro h0; rw [h0, mul_zero] at hprod; exact zero_ne_one hprod
      have step : (α ^ p) ^ (p - 1) * α ^ (p - 1) = 1 := by
        rw [← mul_pow, mul_comm (α ^ p) α, hprod, one_pow]
      rw [key1] at step
      have e4 : α ^ 2 * (α ^ p) ^ 2 = 1 := by rw [← mul_pow, hprod, one_pow]
      have key2 : (α ^ p) ^ (p - 1) = α ^ 2 := mul_right_cancel₀ (pow_ne_zero 2 hnz) (step.trans e4.symm)
      have hne : α - α ^ p ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hβne)
      have heq := h7 (p - 1)
      rw [key1, key2] at heq
      have heq2 : (a (p - 1) : AdjoinRoot f) * (α - α ^ p) = (-3) * (α - α ^ p) := by
        rw [heq]; linear_combination (α ^ p - α) * hsum
      exact mul_right_cancel₀ hne heq2
    have h9 : (a (p - 1) : ZMod p) = -3 := by
      have hmap := map_intCast (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)) (a (p - 1))
      rw [h8] at hmap
      have hneg : (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)) (-3 : ZMod p) = -3 := by
        rw [map_neg]
        exact congrArg Neg.neg (map_ofNat _ 3)
      rw [← hneg] at hmap
      exact (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AdjoinRoot f)).injective hmap
    have h10 : ((a (p - 1) + 3 : ℤ) : ZMod p) = 0 := by
      push_cast
      rw [h9]; ring
    exact (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd (a (p - 1) + 3) p).mp h10

theorem ballot_matrix_det (n : ℕ) : Matrix.det (Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n ↦ ((i.val + j.val + 2).choose (i.val + 1) : ℤ))) = (n : ℤ) + 1:= by
  set B : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ := Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n ↦ ((i.val + j.val + 2).choose (i.val + 1) : ℤ)) with hB
  set M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℤ := Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n ↦ ((i.val + 1).choose (j.val + 1) : ℤ)) with hM
  set x : Fin n → ℤ := fun i => (-1:ℤ) ^ (i.val) with hx
  have hMdet : M.det = 1 := by
    rw [hM, Matrix.det_of_lowerTriangular]
    · simp
    · intro i j hij
      simp only [Matrix.of_apply]
      have : (i:ℕ) < j := hij
      norm_cast
      exact Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (by omega)
  have hMx : ∀ i : Fin n, (M.mulVec x) i = 1 := by
    intro i
    show ∑ j, M i j * x j = 1
    simp only [hM, hx, Matrix.of_apply]
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun j => ((i.val+1).choose (j+1) : ℤ) * (-1:ℤ)^j) n]
    have hsucc := Finset.sum_range_succ' (fun k => (-1:ℤ)^k * ((i.val+1).choose k : ℤ)) n
    have hilt := i.isLt
    have hext : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range ((i.val+1)+1), (-1:ℤ)^k * ((i.val+1).choose k : ℤ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (-1:ℤ)^k * ((i.val+1).choose k : ℤ) := by
      apply Finset.sum_subset
      · intro y hy; simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hy ⊢; omega
      · intro k hk hk'
        simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk hk'
        have hlt2 : i.val + 1 < k := by omega
        simp [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt hlt2]
    have halt := @Int.alternating_sum_range_choose (i.val+1)
    rw [← hext, halt] at hsucc
    simp only [Nat.add_eq_zero_iff, one_ne_zero, and_false, if_false, Nat.choose_zero_right, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, pow_zero] at hsucc
    have hswap : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (-1:ℤ) ^ k * -1 * ((i.val + 1).choose (k + 1) : ℤ) = - ∑ i_1 ∈ Finset.range n, ((i.val + 1).choose (i_1 + 1) : ℤ) * (-1:ℤ) ^ i_1 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro k hk
      ring
    simp only [pow_succ] at hsucc
    rw [hswap] at hsucc
    linarith
  have hBeq : B = M * (1 + Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n => x i * x j)) * (Matrix.transpose M) := by
    have step1 : ∀ i k : Fin n, (M * (1 + Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n => x i * x j))) i k = M i k + x k := by
      intro i k
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.add_apply, Matrix.one_apply, Matrix.of_apply, mul_add]
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      have e1 : (∑ y, M i y * if y = k then (1:ℤ) else 0) = M i k := by simp
      have e2 : (∑ y, M i y * (x y * x k)) = (M.mulVec x) i * x k := by
        show (∑ y, M i y * (x y * x k)) = (∑ y, M i y * x y) * x k
        rw [Finset.sum_mul]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y hy
        ring
      rw [e1, e2, hMx i]
      ring
    have step2 : ∀ i j : Fin n, (M * (1 + Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n => x i * x j)) * (Matrix.transpose M)) i j = (M * Matrix.transpose M) i j + 1 := by
      intro i j
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp only [step1, Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rw [Matrix.mul_apply]
      simp only [Matrix.transpose_apply]
      rw [show (∑ x_1, (M i x_1 + x x_1) * M j x_1) = (∑ x_1, M i x_1 * M j x_1) + ∑ x_1, x x_1 * M j x_1 from by rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]; apply Finset.sum_congr rfl; intro y hy; ring]
      have e3 : (∑ y, x y * M j y) = (M.mulVec x) j := by
        show (∑ y, x y * M j y) = ∑ y, M j y * x y
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro y hy
        ring
      rw [e3, hMx j]
    have vandermonde : ∀ (a b : ℕ), ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (a+1), a.choose p * b.choose p = (a+b).choose a := by
      intro a b
      have h := Nat.add_choose_eq a b a
      rw [Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_eq_sum_range_succ (fun i j => a.choose i * b.choose j)] at h
      have hrefl := Finset.sum_range_reflect (fun k => a.choose k * b.choose (a - k)) (a+1)
      rw [h, ← hrefl]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro y hy
      simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hy
      have hya : y ≤ a := by omega
      rw [Nat.add_sub_cancel, Nat.sub_sub_self hya, Nat.choose_symm hya]
    have key : ∀ i j : Fin n, (∑ k : Fin n, (i.val+1).choose (k.val+1) * (j.val+1).choose (k.val+1)) + 1 = (i.val+j.val+2).choose (i.val+1) := by
      intro i j
      rw [Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun k => (i.val+1).choose (k+1) * (j.val+1).choose (k+1)) n]
      have hv := vandermonde (i.val+1) (j.val+1)
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ'] at hv
      simp only [Nat.choose_zero_right, mul_one] at hv
      have heq : i.val + 1 + (j.val+1) = i.val + j.val + 2 := by omega
      rw [heq] at hv
      have hext : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (i.val+1), (i.val+1).choose (k+1) * (j.val+1).choose (k+1) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (i.val+1).choose (k+1) * (j.val+1).choose (k+1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_subset
        · intro y hy; simp only [Finset.mem_range] at hy ⊢; have := i.isLt; omega
        · intro k hk hk'
          simp only [Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hk hk'
          simp [Nat.choose_eq_zero_of_lt (show i.val + 1 < k + 1 by omega)]
      rw [hext] at hv
      exact hv
    ext i j
    rw [step2]
    show B i j = (M * Matrix.transpose M) i j + 1
    rw [hB, hM]
    simp only [Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply]
    have hkey := key i j
    have hcast := congrArg (Nat.cast : ℕ → ℤ) hkey
    push_cast at hcast
    linarith [hcast]
  have hN : (1 + Matrix.of (fun i j : Fin n => x i * x j)).det = 1 + ∑ i, x i * x i := by
    have e1 : (Matrix.of fun i j : Fin n => x i * x j) = Matrix.replicateCol Unit x * Matrix.replicateRow Unit x := by ext i j; simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
    rw [e1, Matrix.det_one_add_mul_comm, Matrix.det_unique]
    simp [Matrix.mul_apply]
  have hsq : ∑ i : Fin n, x i * x i = n := by
    have hone : ∀ i : Fin n, x i * x i = 1 := by
      intro i
      simp only [hx]
      rw [← pow_add]
      exact Even.neg_one_pow ⟨i.val, by ring⟩
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hone i)]
    simp
  rw [hBeq, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_mul, Matrix.det_transpose, hMdet, hN, hsq]
  ring

      have e01 : (M^2) 0 1 = 0 := by rw [hM]; rfl

              · simp
              · simp [hb]
          rw [Fintype.card_congr hEquiv, Fintype.card_sum]
